SELECT ACID, BANK_ID, COUNT(*) CNT FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER
WHERE ISLATEST = 1 
GROUP BY ACID, BANK_ID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID
WHERE BDG.FORACID like '019b1d4400c5735888536080c6d8e438' AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1' AND BDG.ISACTIVE = '1'

LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDG.ACID = BDT.ACID
WHERE BDG.FORACID like '1f7e624839a1906a228236b08d8fb45c' AND BDG.ISLATEST = '1' AND BDG.ISACTIVE = '1'

SELECT MAX(EOD_DATE) AS MAX_EOD_DATE FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE

SELECT MAX(INSERT_DTTM) AS INSERT_DTTM, EOD_DATE FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE
GROUP BY EOD_DATE 
ORDER BY EOD_DATE DESC

SELECT TOP 1 ACID, EOD_DATE, END_EOD_DATE FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE
WHERE INSERT_DTTM = '2023-09-15'

select count(1) SOURCE_NOT_IN_TARGET from BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance_DEP_YTD_SRC A
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance_DEP_YTD_TGT B WHERE
convert(varchar,A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID)
AND convert(varchar,A.AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE) = convert(varchar,B.AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE)
AND convert(date,A.PERIODENDDATE) = convert(date,B.PERIODENDDATE)
AND A.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = B.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
AND A.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
)

select count(1) SOURCE_NOT_IN_TARGET 
from BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance_DEP_YTD_SRC
where concat(convert(varchar,CUSTOMERACCOUNTID),convert(varchar,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE),
convert(date,PERIODENDDATE),FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE) 
not in
(SELECT concat(convert(varchar,CUSTOMERACCOUNTID),convert(varchar,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE),
convert(date,PERIODENDDATE),FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE)  
FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP')


WITH TEMP_TABLE_SRC AS (
    SELECT CustomerAccountId, MAX(PeriodEndDate) AS PeriodEndDate,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance_DEP_YTD_SRC
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
)
select count(1) SRC_MAX 
from TEMP_TABLE_SRC 
where concat(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),convert(varchar,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE),convert(date,PERIODENDDATE),FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE) 
not in
(SELECT concat(convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId),convert(varchar,AGGREGATEBALANCETYPE),convert(date,PERIODENDDATE),FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE)  
FROM BNKM.CasaTdAggregateBalance
where sourcesystemcode = 'DEP')
